name: Deadly Jolt (AVV)
body:
School evocation (electricity); Level priestess (avv) 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V,S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With this spell, the caster’s touch inflicts 10 points of electrical damage per caster level (to a maximum of 150 points at 15th level). Any creature that takes damage from this spell must also make a Fortitude save or be knocked prone and stunned for 1 round after being touched.

When delivering the deadly jolt, you gain a +3 bonus on attack rolls if the opponent is wearing metal armor (or is carrying a metal weapon or is made of metal).
